title: Traits
description: The properties the analysis would give a script, a task, a query or a file: what each means, how it carries across a call, and what can establish it.

composes.description: What a call of something with the trait makes of the caller.

established.description: inferred: the analysis works it out. declared: the author says so in the header, where review looks, as with Rust's unsafe. enforced: the runtime makes it so.
